_comment: THE PINNED TOOLCHAIN — one machine-readable source of truth, because it used to be five prose
copies of a MUTABLE tag (open ruling Q14, raised E76, built E79).
`emscripten/emsdk:latest` is not a version, it is a moving pointer: it named emcc 6.0.2 when the
shipped artifact was linked (2026-07-01) and names 6.0.5 today (2026-07-29 build). Following the
recipe verbatim would therefore relink the kernel with a compiler that `OCCT_BUILD_ID` does not
name, and nothing would have said so — the .wasm carried no version string at all.
`buildId` is the string `tools/kernel-build/src/kernel.cpp` computes FROM ITS OWN COMPILER at
compile time and `packages/kernel-occt/src/kernel.ts` declares. All three are checked against each
other by `tests/kernel-build-pin.test.ts`, and the kernel refuses to boot if the artifact disagrees.
⚠ CHANGING `emsdk.digest` CHANGES THE COMPILER AND THEREFORE THE GEOMETRY — this file is in the
re-seed gate's GEOMETRY_PATHS for the same reason `link.sh` is.

emsdk.verifiedBy: T-022 — relinked on this digest in 75 s and the artifact came back BYTE-IDENTICAL to the one committed here: wasm sha256 f34fef311af31cd63d1804147f6f8bde58d44a07c4b864193a1fd1ac5223d56a, glue sha256 044baac643940196224f4e70cb2ae66997f9f8baf60e82fc8774fef4a7568db5 before `postlink.mjs` runs. Entry 79 first proved the pin on 2026-08-05, but against the artifact as it stood BEFORE that entry's own `toolchainId()` change (wasm sha256 819ff12cbd627fd7d8a5e73e30b0d34f7f5b056702b23c38e218ad6784a6c696), so its numbers no longer name anything committed.

postlink: The committed glue is the linker's output with `postlink.mjs` applied; the committed .wasm is the linker's output unmodified.
